inspection.style: hand-painted anime forest rock with light neutral gray-blue mineral masses, cool blue fissures and restrained sage moss

integration_notes: Use native albedo RGB only. The image contains no roughness, metallic, AO or tangent normal channels.
Use soft smooth mesh normals and avoid a faceted normal map.
Use moderate world/UV scale and rotate instances. Blended triplanar projection can conceal exposed wrap seams on large modules.
The original is non-power-of-two; use the engine texture power-of-two resampling option if mip generation for the target requires it.
